answer_key._how: Judgment labels only, per profile. Every activity not listed for a profile is irrelevant to it. breaks = hard-constraint ids the activity text shows it breaks; dislike = one of the student's dislikes; schedule fit is NOT stored, code computes it from available_windows. overlap_set = the overlapping relevant events the query refers to (same day, overlapping times); exactly one of them is correct. Correct answer = event in the overlap_set that is relevant, not a dislike, breaks nothing, and fits the schedule. Clubs are relevant but can't go on the calendar.
